firm_data.firm_description: LawrenceQueen is a Richmond-based law firm dedicated exclusively to employment law, representing workers who have suffered from wrongful termination, discrimination, harassment, or retaliation.
notable_facts: The firm's attorneys are members of the National Employment Lawyer’s Association, Virginia Employment Lawyer’s Association, and Virginia Trial Lawyer’s Association’s Employment Law Section.
Barbara Queen was named 2021 Pro Bono Attorney of the Year by Cancer LINC.

email.subject: AI for LawrenceQueen, built for employment law firms
email.body:
Hi Lori,

Your team at LawrenceQueen handles some of the most demanding employment law cases, wrongful termination, discrimination, harassment, retaliation. With 6 attorneys managing this caseload across Richmond, precision and client trust are everything.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: efficiency without sacrificing quality.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now moving into Virginia to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to show how ex-lawyers like us are helping firms like yours compete with larger competitors.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
